scope: Exploratory matched-seed 200 ms references for the pi0.5 independent-clock deadline study

analysis_plan.comparison: Within each available suite and joint seed, compare the registered 175 ms cell with the 200 ms nominal reference.
analysis_plan.cluster_unit: LIBERO task; four episodes within a task are not treated as iid deployment draws.
analysis_plan.pooling: Do not pool suites or seeds into a universal deadline or deployment estimate.
analysis_plan.interpretation: Use 200 ms as a service-specific nominal reference, not as a no-deadline or unguarded condition.
analysis_plan.extension_rule: Do not add further deadline values after inspecting these cells.

stop_conditions: provider failure, missing inference/simulation overlap, worker not stopped, or validator invalid
checkpoint attestation, OpenPI commit, or runtime source hashes differ from the fixed protocol
less than 60 minutes of server lease remains before starting another cell
do not stop or extend a cell based on an intermediate success rate
claim_boundaries: exploratory matched-seed references, not a confirmatory plateau estimate
not an official LIBERO leaderboard score
not a no-deadline or unguarded baseline
not hardware safety or real-robot deployment evidence
not cross-model superiority or a universal VLA deadline threshold
